title: research: audit exact T74 moment endpoints
body:
## Summary

Adds a bounded exact-rational audit of the moment acceptance boundary in PR #3576, pinned to its exact `PROOF.md` and `rate.py` bytes. The audit binds PR #3576's profile and order to the retained PR #2979 inputs, confirms the strict upper/lower endpoint directions and sigma gap, and exercises equality, straddling, endpoint-corruption, and inward-rounding controls.

No endpoint-consumption defect was found. This checks the published common intervals; it does not rederive either enclosure engine or establish production T74, supplier, outer-transfer, or multiplication-theorem admission. No new `κ` or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Verification

- `python3 -I -B research/moment-endpoint-boundary/verify.py` — `PASS_EXACT_MOMENT_ENDPOINT_ACCEPTANCE` on Python 3.14.8.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/moment-endpoint-boundary --check-only` — `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- The registered Python 3.12 replay is pending because `python3.12` is not installed on this laptop.

## Credit

Credit Hiroki Kumazaki and PR #3576; Douglas Colkitt and Nick Petalas for the retained interval engines; Jose Manuel for PR #3562/#3477; Marius-Paul Dumitrean, Jeremy Kothe, and the cited predecessor authors for PR #2979 and its T74 source lineage.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/moment-endpoint-boundary` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/moment-endpoint-boundary --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
